text: The County seeks a qualified actuarial firm to provide an annual valuation of its self-insured workers compensation program.

citations.text: The County is seeking a qualified Actuary Firm to provide an annual actuarial valuation of the County’s self-insured workers compensation program.

text: The plan was established under Local Law #1 of 1979 and amended under Local Law #10 of 2008.

citations.text: In accordance with the provisions of the New York State Workers’ Compensation Law, Ulster County established a pooled Self-Insurance Plan by Local Law #1 of 1979.
The law was amended under Local Law #10 of 2008.

text: The plan covers employees of the County, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College.

citations.text: The plan provides coverage to employees of the County, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts within the County, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College.

text: The County administers the plan with County employees and a third-party administrator, under oversight of the County Executive.

citations.text: The administration of this plan is accomplished with County employees in conjunction with a Third-party administrator and is overseen by the County Executive.

text: The County has 1,609 employees, the community college has 342 employees, there are approximately 941 active volunteer firepersons, and approximately 5,745 government/local education employees.

citations.text: The County currently has 1,609 employees (1,426 full time and 183 part time), Ulster County Community College has 342 employees (181 full time and 161 part time), and there are approximately 941 active volunteer firepersons with approximately 5,745 government/local education employees.

text: Annual liability estimates are requested for years ending December 31, 2026, 2027, and 2028, with two optional one-year renewals for years ending December 31, 2029 and 2030.

text: Each year, the vendor must produce a report containing a three-year forecast.

text: The actuarial study must estimate total year-end reserves on both discounted and undiscounted bases.

citations.text: The study must provide an estimate of the total reserves as of the end of the year on both a discounted and undiscounted basis.

text: The work includes independent analysis of the workers compensation loss reserve, including incurred but not reported losses.

citations.text: Workers’ Compensation Actuarial Services will consist of an independent actuarial analysis of the loss reserve (incurred but not reported) related to the Workers’ Compensation Coverage.

text: The actuary must estimate upcoming calendar-year losses by agency and future loss payments by calendar year for the next two (2) years.

citations.text: •Estimate of the expected losses for the upcoming calendar year by agency.
•Estimate of the future loss payments by calendar year for the next two (2) years.

text: The actuary must calculate discounted and non-discounted unpaid liabilities at year’s end.

citations.text: •Calculation of discounted and non-discounted unpaid liabilities at year’s end.

text: The actuary must calculate each participant’s amount to cover open liabilities if it withdraws from the plan.

citations.text: •Calculation for each individual participant to cover open liabilities if they withdraw from the plan.

text: The actuary must address anticipated and unanticipated contingencies.

citations.text: •Anticipated and unanticipated contingencies.

text: The actuary must allocate reserves and/or funding to individual plan participants.

citations.text: •Allocation of reserves and/or funding to individual plan participants.

text: The actuary must estimate necessary reserves for known claims and incurred-but-not-reported claims.

citations.text: •Estimate of necessary reserves to include a provision for both known claims and claims that have been incurred but not reported (IBNR).

text: The actuary must certify loss reserve estimates and provide a Statement of Actuarial Opinion on actuarially derived items in County financial statements.

citations.text: The actuary must provide certification of his or her loss reserve estimates and must provide a Statement of Actuarial Opinion on actuarially derived items in the Ulster County financial statements.
